title: Greywater Bay Rising Revisited
author: Freya Joubert
blurb: Ada Coldharbour, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
